decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - That the London Borough of Hillingdon be informed that this local planning authority notes the details submitted in compliance with conditions A90, B41, C47, D48, E57, F40, G42, H34, I36, J31, K36 and M32 of the main and subsidiary planning applications related to Terminal 5, has no objection to the Construction Workers Public Transport Strategy 2002/03 subject to the following considerations:

(1) That commitment to provide transport to other locations, such as town centres should there be sufficient demand is confirmed.

(2)  That a commitment is made to transport construction workers from the date of commemcement.
description: Details of construction workers public transport strategy 2002/3 in compliance with condition A90 of the main planning application (Ref 47853/93/246) dated 20.11.01
